svg.aria-label: Build and validation results, one run on 19 Nov 2026: 325,140,977 HMDA records on one schema for 2007-2025, equal to the raw line counts in 19 of 19 years; 0 integrity failures in 630 checks (483 pass, 128 external mismatches, 19 informational); 0 differences from the FFIEC's published derived race, ethnicity and sex over 137,678,531 records; 234 of 261 published totals matched.
